item.title: Cross-Device AR: How to Ensure a Seamless Experience
item.description: Augmented Reality (AR) UX has endless opportunities to make a usable and engaging product. Place-based storytelling can show information spatially in a way that is easier to understand than abstract ideas. However, AR isn’t always practical or safe to use, which makes it hard for users to want to use it all the time. item.title: Interaction Design Foundation Reviews: How to Successfully Switch to a UX Career in 2026
item.description: Switching careers, regardless of whether you’re forced into it due to circumstances or not, is tough. Upskilling, hunting for jobs without prior industry-relevant experience, and establishing oneself from scratch requires time, effort, and in most cases, significant financial investment. If you’re considering switching careers, know that you're not alone. Many past members of the Interaction Design Foundation (IxDF) have been in similar situations. And many have crossed that bridge successfully.
